accepted.evidence: Turner 8179 explicitly lists Khetrani piū́ 'father' beside Lahnda peo and Punjabi piu/peo. Grierson peū has the same p-vowel-u stem and exact kin sense. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.

Turner 9349 gives Khetrani bhε̃ṇ 'sister' beside Lahnda bhêṇ. Grierson's bʰēn preserves the same bʰ-n sister stem; its source nasal notation is not silently changed. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.

Turner 8265 explicitly lists Khetrani putr̥ 'son' and Lahnda puttur. Grierson's putur has the shared put-r consonants and exact family sense. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.

Turner 5009 explicitly cites Khetrani cālī f. 'goat' under chāgala. Grierson's cālī 'female goat' matches form, gender, and sense. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.

Turner 6152 cites Khetrani dant and Lahnda dand 'tooth'. Grierson's dand matches the latter local assimilation; the source's voiced final consonant is retained. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.

Turner 7636 explicitly lists Khetrani pakhī 'bird' under pakṣín. Grierson's pakʰī is the same bird word in the source transcription. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.

Turner 9480 explicitly cites Khetrani bah 'fire' under bhāsá 'light', beside Lahnda bhāh. Grierson's bah has the exact Khetrani form and local fire sense. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.

Turner 10104 explicitly lists Khetrani māh 'moon, month' under mā́sa. Grierson's māh 'Moon' is the moon sense of that same form. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.
